name: luxuryGold
title: Luxury Gold
description: Opulent champagne and burnished gold leaf textures, obsidian marble surfaces, regal serif typography, and majestic slow-motion choreography.
do: Polish bevels and extruded metallic contours with sharp specular glints
Keep typography majestic with generous tracking and centered symmetry
Float subtle golden embers in foreground camera plane
dont: Do not use frantic fast cutting or erratic glitch distortions
Avoid cheap bright neon greens or cartoon primary tones
Never crowd the composition; let negative space radiate exclusivity
